description: This file contains microbenchmark tests for normalization operators in PyTorch, including LayerNorm, RMSNorm, BatchNorm1d/2d/3d, and GroupNorm, with configurations for different input sizes and training/evaluation modes.

classes.name: BatchNorm3dBenchmark
